pages.title: Spell Combos
pages.text: Spells remember each other. Cast them in the right order and they become more than the sum of their parts.$(br2)$(l)Shatter$(): strike a creature chilled by $(l)Frost Nova$() with $(l)Spark$() or $(l)Void Lance$() within five seconds. Double damage.

$(l)Thermal Shock$(): burn a chilled creature with $(l)Firebolt$(). Three more hearts of damage.$(br2)$(l)Slam$(): $(l)Repel$() a creature into a wall. It is stunned for three seconds.$(br2)$(l)Exposed$(): a creature made to glow by $(l)Reveal$() takes a quarter more damage from all magic.
